query: Dựng video du lịch 30s dọc từ các clip Sài Gòn, Hội An, Hạ Long, phong cách năng động, không cần tiếng.
expected_behavior: Writes and saves a storyboard (message, arc, direction_id travel_energy or similar, one breather, negative list) before composing
Applies a creative direction and keeps transitions to one primary plus accents from its vocabulary
Uses a hero technique that orients the journey (map_journey or globe_dive) via compose_cinematic with dry_run first
Runs audit_timeline before rendering and motion_audit + cut_audit after, and fixes the 25/30 fps duplicate-frame finding (retime/conform) or states it
Compiles credits with project_credits instead of typing them

query: Video của tôi xem như slideshow, sửa giúp cho chuyên nghiệp hơn.
expected_behavior: Measures before changing: motion_audit (calm shots, static spans, uniform energy) and audit_timeline (simultaneous_entrances, transition_variety, dip_transition, missing_entrance)
Applies apply_direction restyle to unify curves, stagger entrances and add ambient idle instead of adding random effects
Adds something that crosses shot boundaries (attached layers, match cut, continuous camera) and varies energy with one breather
Re-renders and re-measures the same frames, reporting before/after numbers

query: Tìm thêm footage đèn lồng Hội An có license để dùng.
expected_behavior: Uses find_sources (search only) and presents file name, source page, licence and size
Waits for explicit user approval before fetch_source and passes expected_bytes
Registers the file with licence/credit and later traces it through project_credits

query: Làm cảnh mở đầu chữ tên địa danh nằm sau người trong clip.
expected_behavior: Runs track_subject then edit_subject foreground for the same window and attaches the alpha video
Uses compose_cinematic text_behind_subject (shot motion hold, focus 0.5/0.5, fit cover) and reports the covered range
Verifies with review_frames: covered_fraction near target, contrast_p10, same_as_background_fraction, and adjusts placement or adds shadow

query: Cắt video theo nhịp bài nhạc này và làm phong cách VHS thập niên 90.
expected_behavior: Calls beat_track and checks the BPM for half/double-time before snap_cuts_to_beats (dry_run first)
Applies the retro_vhs direction with finish (vhs/scanlines look, grain) and stepped or ease_out motion
Verifies with cut_audit (rhythm) and motion_audit after rendering
